title: New datasets in the SDKP
summary: We are pleased to announce the addition of two new datasets to the Sleep Disorder Knowledge Portal.
bodyHtml:
We are pleased to announce the addition of two new datasets to the Sleep Disorder Knowledge Portal:

  • The Obstructive sleep apnea GWAS dataset (Chen et al. 2018, Multiethnic Meta-Analysis Identifies RAI1 as a Possible Obstructive Sleep Apnea-related Quantitative Trait Locus in Men) analyzed genetic associations with the apnea-hypopnea index (AHI), a measure of pauses in breathing during sleep. Associations were determined overall and also specifically during REM and non-REM sleep in nearly 20,000 individuals of multiple ancestries.
  • The Sleeping oxyhemoglobin saturation GWAS dataset (Cade et al. 2019, Associations of Variants In the Hexokinase 1 and Interleukin 18 Receptor Regions with Oxyhemoglobin Saturation During Sleep) includes genetic associations in nearly 23,000 multi-ethnic individuals for several measures of sleep disordered breathing: average oxyhemoglobin saturation during sleep; minimum oxyhemoglobin saturation during sleep; and percentage of sleep with oxyhemoglobin saturation under 90%. 

Both of these datasets are described in detail on the SDKP Data page. You can view the results of both studies at various locations in the SDKP:

  • on Gene pages (view an example) on the Top Variants and High-impact Variants tabs, and in LocusZoom plots;
  • on Variant pages (view an example) in PheWAS and Forest plots, in the Associations across all datasets table, and in LocusZoom plots;
  • in Manhattan plots (view an example), accessible from the "Explore by phenotype" search on the SDKP home page;
  • variant associations from these studies may also be searched using the Variant Finder.
In addition to being integrated into the SDKP, summary statistics from the Sleeping oxyhemoglobin saturation GWAS dataset are also available for download from the SDKP Data page.
 
Please check out the new results in the SDKP and contact us with any questions or suggestions.
